title: Milo considers his options

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Sadly no. I was unable to purchase her property at a reduced price.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sadly no. I was unable to purchase her property at a reduced price.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: It seems Nola Berg knows the number one rule of business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It seems Nola Berg knows the number one rule of business.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I hire a criminal to threaten my business rivals, allowing me to vanquish my foes. My business will be the last one standing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hire a criminal to threaten my business rivals, allowing me to vanquish my foes. My business will be the last one standing.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I can't afford a criminal enforcer. And I am not sure I really WANT to threaten anyone. Oh, and I don't know any criminals. Do you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't afford a criminal enforcer. And I am not sure I really WANT to threaten anyone. Oh, and I don't know any criminals. Do you?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I feel it may be escalating the situation in ways I may regret... but what other options do I have? I am not a competent businessman. That much is clear.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel it may be escalating the situation in ways I may regret... but what other options do I have? I am not a competent businessman. That much is clear.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Hmm... I am sure I can come up with something. Then, when I am the last one standing, you will be rewarded for your advice and support.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmm... I am sure I can come up with something. Then, when I am the last one standing, you will be rewarded for your advice and support.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I think you are right. I will join forces with my enemies... then stab them in the back when they least expect it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you are right. I will join forces with my enemies... then stab them in the back when they least expect it.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Yes... I'll look into it. When I am the last one standing, you will be rewarded for your advice and support.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes... I'll look into it. When I am the last one standing, you will be rewarded for your advice and support.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: I must congratulate you. The Humor Bot successfully attracted the rats. Nola Berg suffered a considerable loss in her day's takings.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I must congratulate you. The Humor Bot successfully attracted the rats. Nola Berg suffered a considerable loss in her day's takings.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So did you take over her business?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So did you take over her business?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So did you take over her business?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So did you take over her business?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Which is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Which is?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Turn every crisis into an opportunity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Turn every crisis into an opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good advice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good advice.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Well, Nola Berg sold the rats to someone called "Gladstone", thus turning a tidy profit. It seems collecting rats is his "thing."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, Nola Berg sold the rats to someone called "Gladstone", thus turning a tidy profit. It seems collecting rats is his "thing."

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what now?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Well I have two suggestions for our next step. I would like to hear which you favor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I have two suggestions for our next step. I would like to hear which you favor.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are they?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are they?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Well the first is that I attempt to partner with some of my business rivals. If you can't beat them - and it seems likely I cannot - then I must join them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well the first is that I attempt to partner with some of my business rivals. If you can't beat them - and it seems likely I cannot - then I must join them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And your second idea?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And your second idea?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Whoa, that seems a bit extreme!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoa, that seems a bit extreme!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Whoa, that seems a bit extreme!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Whoa, that seems a bit extreme!

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Yes, well there are a few details I still need to iron out with that plan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, well there are a few details I still need to iron out with that plan.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What details?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What details?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I could look into it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could look into it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're still learning.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're still learning.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Either we try to partner up with a business rival, or we hire a criminal to threaten them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Either we try to partner up with a business rival, or we hire a criminal to threaten them.

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: Well... I feel like all of my schemes have come to very little in the end. I am willing to follow your lead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... I feel like all of my schemes have come to very little in the end. I am willing to follow your lead.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are the options again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are the options again?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You have to be ruthless. Hire a criminal to threaten your rivals.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have to be ruthless. Hire a criminal to threaten your rivals.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You have to be ruthless. Hire a criminal to threaten your rivals.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You have to be ruthless. Hire a criminal to threaten your rivals.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hiring an underworld contact is a well established technique for business success in Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hiring an underworld contact is a well established technique for business success in Nivalis.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Hiring an underworld contact is a well established technique for business success in Nivalis.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Hiring an underworld contact is a well established technique for business success in Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If I did I wouldn't tell you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I did I wouldn't tell you!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If I did I wouldn't tell you!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If I did I wouldn't tell you!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure that's the number one rule of anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure that's the number one rule of anything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure that's the number one rule of anything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure that's the number one rule of anything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I agree. You're terrible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I agree. You're terrible.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's no need to threaten anyone. You should try to partner up with a business rival.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's no need to threaten anyone. You should try to partner up with a business rival.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There's no need to threaten anyone. You should try to partner up with a business rival.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There's no need to threaten anyone. You should try to partner up with a business rival.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: None of these options are good. You need to think of something else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: None of these options are good. You need to think of something else.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: None of these options are good. You need to think of something else.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: None of these options are good. You need to think of something else.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's the least you can do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the least you can do.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's the least you can do.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's the least you can do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's always great to destroy the competition!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's always great to destroy the competition!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's always great to destroy the competition!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's always great to destroy the competition!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's tougher than you thought?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's tougher than you thought?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Corruption is your friend?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Corruption is your friend?

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: No, not that one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, not that one.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Gladstone? Yeah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gladstone? Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's really not up to me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's really not up to me!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's really not up to me!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's really not up to me!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The second can only be better!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The second can only be better!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The second can only be better!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The second can only be better!

nodes.speaker: Milo
nodes.text: When I am the last one standing, you will be rewarded for your advice and support.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When I am the last one standing, you will be rewarded for your advice and support.
